purpose: Test whether official 2012-2016 NFL Game Books can directly bound the game-day P(active) denominator, avoiding inference from ambiguous weekly-roster status codes.

scientific_disclosure.exploratory_replay_before_contract: All 1,280 V1-captured PDFs were inspected structurally. Every game exposed one Lineups, Substitutions, Did Not Play and Not Active block; all 2,560 team partitions had disjoint active/inactive player keys and no duplicate player keys across active sections.

source_semantics.authority: official NFLGSIS Gamebook.pdf Game Summary first-page roster structures
source_semantics.positive_candidate_definition: union of player entries listed in Lineups, Substitutions and Did Not Play for that team
source_semantics.negative_definition: player entry listed in Not Active for that team

parser.implementation: pdftotext -layout followed by deterministic first-page two-column extraction
parser.reason_for_count_sanity_gate: The full exploratory raw-source replay produced only 45- or 46-player active candidate sets and 50-53 total parsed roster entries. The gate is a parser-completeness sanity check, not an NFL outcome or betting assumption.
